label: Canadian TFSA
Kanada 2026: skattefri avkastning och ut: Canada 2026: tax-free returns and withdrawals. Model all of a person’s TFSAs as one account with verified remaining contribution room at projection start, including the CAD 7,000 already granted for the year. Contributions use that room. Withdrawals are restored on January 1 of the following year along with the next year’s assumed CAD 7,000 in rule-year money. Losses do not create new room. Non-qualified investments and excess contributions are unsupported.
Totalt kvarvarande utrymme nu, inklusive: Total remaining room now, including this year’s limit and previous unused room. Withdrawals during the current year must not yet be added back.
Den nya TFSA-insättningen vid start över: The new TFSA contribution at the start exceeds the verified contribution room.
